ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Human Services System
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of funds in Minnesota's human services system to identify potential areas of fraud and abuse.
questions: How are funds allocated in Minnesota's human services system?
What are the most common types of fraud in human services?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough analysis of the financial transactions in Minnesota's human services system could reveal patterns of fraud and abuse, which could inform policy changes and improve oversight.
